def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marks = [(r, row[0]) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
             if row and all(v == row[0] for v in row) and row[0] != 0]
    if not marks:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    # The row colors are samples of the repeating horizontal-stripe pattern.
    # Select the shortest period consistent with every observed stripe.
    period = h
    residues = None
    for p in range(1, h + 1):
        trial = {}
        for r, color in marks:
            k = r % p
            if k in trial and trial[k] != color:
                break
            trial[k] = color
        else:
            period, residues = p, trial
            break

    known = sorted(residues)

    def color_at(row):
        k = row % period
        if k in residues:
            return residues[k]
        # Fill unobserved phases with the nearest previous known stripe.
        prev = max((x for x in known if x < k), default=known[-1])
        return residues[prev]

    return [[color_at(r)] * w for r in range(h)]
